VizdoomBasic-MultiBinary-v1.name: Basic
VizdoomBasic-MultiBinary-v1.description: A rectangular gray room. The player starts at the center of one long wall and a red circular monster starts at a random position along the opposite wall. The player can move sideways and shoot, and one hit kills the monster.
VizdoomBasic-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Kill the monster quickly while avoiding unnecessary shots.
rewards: -1 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomBasic-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The monster is killed or the 300-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomBasicAudio-MultiBinary-v1.name: Basic Audio
VizdoomBasicAudio-MultiBinary-v1.description: The Basic scenario with an invisible monster that emits sounds. The player can move sideways and shoot, and one hit kills the monster.
VizdoomBasicAudio-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Use the stereo-audio signal to locate and kill the invisible monster quickly while avoiding unnecessary shots.
rewards: -1 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomBasicAudio-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The monster is killed or the 300-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomBasicNotifications-MultiBinary-v1.name: Basic Notifications
VizdoomBasicNotifications-MultiBinary-v1.description: The Basic scenario with three monsters instead of one. An in-game notification identifies which monster should be killed.
VizdoomBasicNotifications-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Read the latest notification and kill the specified monster without killing either wrong monster.
rewards: -1 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomBasicNotifications-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: A monster is killed or the 300-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomDeadlyCorridor-MultiBinary-v1.name: Deadly Corridor
VizdoomDeadlyCorridor-MultiBinary-v1.description: A corridor contains six shooting monsters, with monsters positioned on both sides. A green armor vest is at the far end. Running directly toward it without dealing with the monsters is usually fatal at difficulty level 5.
VizdoomDeadlyCorridor-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Survive the corridor and reach the green armor vest.
rewards: Positive distance change for moving closer to the vest
Negative distance change for moving farther from the vest
VizdoomDeadlyCorridor-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The vest is reached, the player dies, or the 2100-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomDeathmatch-MultiBinary-v1.name: Deathmatch
VizdoomDeathmatch-MultiBinary-v1.description: The player starts at a random location in an arena containing resources. Random monsters spawn periodically and try to kill the player. Different monsters award different kill rewards. The scenario runs at difficulty level 3.
VizdoomDeathmatch-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Collect useful resources, survive, and kill as many monsters as possible.
VizdoomDeathmatch-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The player dies or the 4200-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomDefendCenter-MultiBinary-v1.name: Defend the Center
VizdoomDefendCenter-MultiBinary-v1.description: The player is fixed at the center of a circular arena. Five melee-only monsters spawn along the wall, die from one shot, and respawn after a delay. Ammunition is limited and the scenario runs at difficulty level 3.
VizdoomDefendCenter-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Turn and shoot efficiently to kill as many approaching monsters as possible before dying.
VizdoomDefendCenter-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The player dies or the 2100-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomDefendLine-MultiBinary-v1.name: Defend the Line
VizdoomDefendLine-MultiBinary-v1.description: The player starts at the center of a long wall in a rectangular arena. Three melee monsters and three shooting monsters spawn along the opposite wall. Monsters respawn after death and become tougher over time. Ammunition is limited and the scenario runs at difficulty level 3.
VizdoomDefendLine-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Turn and shoot efficiently to kill as many monsters as possible before dying.

VizdoomHealthGathering-MultiBinary-v1.name: Health Gathering
VizdoomHealthGathering-MultiBinary-v1.description: A rectangular arena has a green acidic floor that periodically damages the player. Medkits are distributed around the map and additional medkits fall from above over time.
VizdoomHealthGathering-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Keep moving, find medkits, and survive for as long as possible.
rewards: +1 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomHealthGathering-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The player dies or the scenario timeout is reached.

VizdoomHealthGatheringSupreme-MultiBinar.name: Health Gathering Supreme
VizdoomHealthGatheringSupreme-MultiBinar.description: A more advanced Health Gathering scenario with a complex map layout. The damaging green acidic floor drains health, while existing and newly spawned medkits restore it.
VizdoomHealthGatheringSupreme-MultiBinar.objective: Navigate the complex map, collect medkits, and survive for as long as possible.
rewards: +1 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomHealthGatheringSupreme-MultiBinar.episode_end: The player dies or the scenario timeout is reached.

VizdoomMyWayHome-MultiBinary-v1.name: My Way Home
VizdoomMyWayHome-MultiBinary-v1.description: A labyrinth-like map contains differently colored interconnected rooms and a dead-end corridor. A green armor vest is always located in the same room, while the player's starting room and facing direction are random.
VizdoomMyWayHome-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Navigate the maze and reach the green armor vest as quickly as possible.
rewards: -0.0001 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomMyWayHome-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The vest is reached or the 2100-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomPredictPosition-MultiBinary-v1.name: Predict Position
VizdoomPredictPosition-MultiBinary-v1.description: A monster moves between the left and right corners of the opposite wall. The player has a rocket launcher with one slow projectile, so the shot must be timed to intersect the moving target.
VizdoomPredictPosition-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Predict the monster's movement and fire the single rocket so the projectile hits it.
rewards: -0.0001 for every tic the player remains alive
VizdoomPredictPosition-MultiBinary-v1.episode_end: The rocket hits the monster or a wall, or the 300-tic timeout is reached.

VizdoomTakeCover-MultiBinary-v1.name: Take Cover
VizdoomTakeCover-MultiBinary-v1.description: The player starts at the center of a long wall in a rectangular arena. Monsters on the opposite side fire projectiles, and more monsters appear over time. The player can only dodge sideways and the scenario runs at difficulty level 4.
VizdoomTakeCover-MultiBinary-v1.objective: Dodge incoming fireballs and survive for as long as possible.
rewards: +1 for every tic the player remains alive
